description: Analyze a JVM thread dump with ThreadMine. Detects deadlocks, CPU spikes, thread pool exhaustion, thread leaks and virtual thread pinning. Returns detected problems, a health score (0-100) and a link to the full interactive report. Pass the dump text in "content", or "file_path" for large dumps. Consumes one analysis from the ThreadMine account's daily quota.

content.description: Raw thread dump text (jstack / jcmd Thread.print / kill -3 output)

file_path.description: Absolute path to a thread dump file — preferred for large dumps

name: analyze_thread_dump
